description: Creates a DRAFT Task from a name + sentence. A Task is for work with people in the loop (someone approves, decides or acts on each item before anything else happens) or a specific process mapped in Compass; its runs are measured. When nobody but you acts on it and you'd just do the same thing each time on a schedule, make a routine instead (routines_create). Use this once the user's sentence feels settled after you've refined it together — then compile it. The sentence should be THEIR words: trigger first ('When a claim arrives…'), then steps, branches, and who decides what. Name rooms, sheets, tables, flows and people by their names, never by id: people read the sentence on the Task's page.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

sentence.description: The process sentence, in the user's words.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_tasks_create
title: Create a draft Task
